fusions.name: Hurled Hive
fusions.desc: Hurls a torn-off hive that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swarm Let Loose
fusions.desc: Shakes a swarm out in a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 25% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Raided Honeycomb
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Hive Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (54% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
